title: Ballot initiative to reverse Missouri's abortion ban
wording: If an initiative were put on a Missouri ballot to reverse the new ban on abortions in Missouri, making it legal for women to receive an abortion in Missouri, how would you vote?
categories: Would vote to continue the ban on abortions|Would vote to reverse the ban, making abortions legal in Missouri|Not sure
partial_note: Asked of only part of the sample in August 2022 (447 of 900 people).

title: Agree with the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade
wording: In June, the United States Supreme Court overturned Roe v Wade, the landmark ruling that established the constitutional right to abortion in the United States during the first two trimesters of pregnancy. Do you agree or disagree with this Supreme Court ruling?
collapse_note: Strongly agree and agree are combined, as are disagree and strongly disagree.
partial_note: Asked of only part of the sample in August 2022 (453 of 900 people).

title: Prosecute a Missouri woman for an abortion in another state
